'''H'kig''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] associated with the [[H'kig]].<ref name="TEGtPaM" />

The written version of the language utilized at least four glyphs: "[[jeh]]," "[[teh]]," "[[peh]]," and "[[tan]]," meaning "the immanent," "the transcendent," "the eternal," and "the conscious essence" respectively. Only "tan" was considered secular enough among the H'kig to be written out fully.<ref name="TEGtPaM" />
